# Northwind Employee Handbook

Welcome to Northwind. This handbook explains how we work, what we expect of each other, and where to find help. It is updated every January.

## Leave

### Annual leave

Full-time employees receive 25 days of annual leave per calendar year, plus public holidays. Unused days up to five may be carried into the next year; the rest expire on 31 March. Request leave in the people portal at least two weeks ahead for anything longer than three days.

### Parental leave

All new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave, whichever parent they are, and may take it in one block or in two blocks within the first year. Parents returning to work may ask for a phased return over four weeks at full pay.

### Sick leave

Sick leave is not capped. Tell your manager before 10:00 on the first day. A doctor's note is needed after three consecutive days.

## Expenses

### Travel

Book travel through the Northwind travel desk. Economy class is standard for flights under six hours; premium economy is allowed beyond that. Hotels are capped at 180 euros per night in major cities and 120 euros elsewhere.

### Meals and client entertainment

Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to 60 euros per day. Client dinners need the manager's approval in advance and are capped at 90 euros per person.

### Claiming

Submit receipts in the expenses app within 30 days. Claims older than 90 days are not reimbursed. Reimbursements are paid on the last Friday of the month.

## Security

### Passwords and devices

Use the company password manager; never reuse a password. Laptops must have full-disk encryption and lock after five minutes. Lost devices must be reported to the security desk within one hour at security@northwind.example.

### Phishing

Forward suspicious email to phish@northwind.example and delete it. The security team runs a phishing test every quarter; repeated failures lead to a short training, not a penalty.

## Remote work

Employees may work remotely up to three days a week. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 in your own time zone, when you should be reachable. A home-office allowance of 400 euros is paid once, after the probation period, for a desk and chair.

## Onboarding

New hires get a laptop on day one, a buddy for the first three months, and a 30-60-90 day plan agreed with their manager. Probation lasts six months and ends with a review conversation.
